title: Surreal Clock
description: A large round clock shows a tower on a big sphere at its center with hands pointing to ten past six. The top half has a blue sky with butterflies bats a globe a skull and other objects while the bottom has yellow sand with more bats a bottle and small spheres.
prompt: a large round clock with roman numerals has a tall ornate tower standing on a giant sphere in the center with clock hands at ten past six. the upper part shows a blue sky filled with orange butterflies black bats a globe a white sphere and small objects. the lower part is yellow sand with a human skull a brown bottle more bats and spheres scattered around.
